verdict.rationale: The docs only describe transcription-mode 'endpointing' settings that trade speed for accuracy via interim vs. context-aware STT results (retell-docs-9, retell-docs-39, retell-docs-48) — this is essentially tunable VAD/endpointing, not a semantic or model-based end-of-turn detector that understands slow speakers are still talking. No evidence pack item describes an LLM- or model-based turn-completion detector distinct from VAD silence timeouts.
